label: Agent Commit
purpose: Represent a commit authored by an AI coding agent.
use_when: Use for agent-authored commits in history views and audit logs.
avoid_when: Do not use for human commits when authorship matters; use the plain commit icon instead.
depicts: A commit node on a line with a plus spark above.

label: Agent Diff
purpose: Represent a code diff produced by an AI coding agent.
use_when: Use for agent-generated diffs, patch reviews, and change previews.
avoid_when: Do not use for file comparison without an agent meaning; use a standard diff icon instead.
depicts: Plus and minus marks beside a dashed divider and a spark.

label: Agent Face
purpose: Represent an AI agent or assistant as a clear, friendly avatar.
use_when: Use as the avatar or marker for an AI agent, assistant, or bot in chats, dashboards, and activity feeds.
avoid_when: Do not use for physical robots or for specific branded assistants that have their own logo.
depicts: A rounded robot head with antenna, two eyes, and a smile.

label: Agent Handoff
purpose: Show one agent handing a task off to another agent.
use_when: Use for delegation and handoff steps in multi-agent workflows and swarm architectures.
avoid_when: Do not use for human-to-human assignment; use a person-based icon instead.
depicts: Two agent nodes with an arced handoff arrow between them.

label: Agent ID Badge
purpose: Represent a scoped identity badge for an AI agent.
use_when: Use for agent identities, scoped credentials, and service account views.
avoid_when: Do not use for human ID cards; use a person badge instead.
depicts: An ID card with a small antenna bot photo and detail lines.

label: Agent Pull Request
purpose: Represent a pull request opened by an AI coding agent.
use_when: Use for agent-authored pull requests in review queues and activity feeds.
avoid_when: Do not use for human pull requests when the distinction matters; use the plain PR icon instead.
depicts: A pull request graph with an antenna dot marking the agent branch.

label: Agent Swarm
purpose: Represent a decentralized swarm of cooperating agents.
use_when: Use for swarm and mesh multi-agent patterns where agents coordinate as peers.
avoid_when: Do not use for supervised hierarchies; use the orchestrator icon instead.
depicts: Five loosely linked agent nodes in a cluster.

label: Agent Wallet
purpose: Represent a wallet owned and operated by an AI agent.
use_when: Use for agent wallets, agent-held funds, and machine payment accounts.
avoid_when: Do not use for human wallets when the distinction matters; use a plain wallet icon instead.
depicts: A wallet with a card slot and a small antenna on top.

label: Approval Gate
purpose: Show that an agent is paused at a gate waiting for human approval.
use_when: Use when an action is queued behind an explicit human consent step, such as a deploy or payment gate.
avoid_when: Do not use for generic paused media or ordinary loading states.
depicts: A gate structure with pause bars inside.

label: AI Glasses
purpose: Represent AI or augmented reality smart glasses.
use_when: Use for smart glasses hardware, AR interfaces, and wearable AI assistants.
avoid_when: Do not use for reading glasses or sunglasses fashion content.
depicts: A pair of rounded glasses with a spark in the right lens.

label: Autonomy Dial
purpose: Represent an adjustable level of agent autonomy or delegation.
use_when: Use for autonomy settings, progressive delegation, and permission levels.
avoid_when: Do not use for volume or brightness dials.
depicts: A dial with a needle and level tick marks.

label: Context Gauge
purpose: Show how much of the model context window is used.
use_when: Use for context window meters in agent status bars and session dashboards.
avoid_when: Do not use for speed or performance gauges unrelated to context.
depicts: A semicircular gauge with a needle and tick marks.

label: Delivery Robot
purpose: Represent a wheeled sidewalk delivery robot.
use_when: Use for last-mile delivery robots, autonomous couriers, and delivery tracking.
avoid_when: Do not use for delivery trucks or human couriers.
depicts: A boxy robot body with two wheels and a parcel front.

label: Done Spark
purpose: Show that an agent task finished successfully, with a touch of delight.
use_when: Use for completed agent tasks, successful runs, and finished checklists.
avoid_when: Do not use for security approvals or verified trust states; use a shield icon instead.
depicts: A bold checkmark with a spark at the top right.

label: Drone Delivery
purpose: Represent a drone carrying a delivery parcel.
use_when: Use for drone delivery services, airborne logistics, and package drops.
avoid_when: Do not use for surveillance or photography drones; use the plain drone icon instead.
depicts: A small drone with a parcel hanging beneath it.

label: Quadcopter Drone
purpose: Represent a quadcopter drone.
use_when: Use for drone hardware, flight controls, and aerial robotics.
avoid_when: Do not use for airplanes or helicopters.
depicts: A center body with four arms and rotor arcs at the corners.

label: Edge AI Chip
purpose: Represent on-device or edge AI compute such as an NPU or local inference hardware.
use_when: Use when the interface refers to on-device AI, local inference, NPUs, or edge compute capability.
avoid_when: Do not use for cloud-hosted AI services, generic CPUs without an AI meaning, or quantum processors; use a matching compute icon instead.
depicts: A processor chip outline with pins on all four sides and a four-point spark in the center.

label: Entangled Pair
purpose: Represent quantum entanglement between two particles.
use_when: Use for entanglement, correlated qubits, and quantum networking.
avoid_when: Do not use for linked accounts or paired devices without a quantum meaning.
depicts: Two overlapping rings, each with a center particle dot.

label: Error Glitch
purpose: Show that an agent or system hit an error or fault.
use_when: Use for failed runs, crashed tools, and fault states in agent dashboards.
avoid_when: Do not use for warnings that do not block progress; use a standard warning icon instead.
depicts: A warning triangle with glitch ticks at its sides.

label: Guardrail Path
purpose: Represent guardrails that keep agent behavior inside policy bounds.
use_when: Use for guardrail settings, policy enforcement, and bounded agent behavior.
avoid_when: Do not use for roads or navigation lanes.
depicts: Two side rails with a dashed path running between them.

label: Hallucination Warn
purpose: Warn that AI output may be hallucinated or needs verification.
use_when: Use for hallucination flags, low-confidence answers, and verify-before-trust prompts.
avoid_when: Do not use for general errors; use the error icon instead.
depicts: A speech bubble with a wavy distorted base and an exclamation mark.

label: Human In Loop
purpose: Show that a human reviews or supervises the agent loop.
use_when: Use for human oversight steps, review checkpoints, and supervised autonomy.
avoid_when: Do not use for user profiles or account pages; use a person icon instead.
depicts: A person inside circular loop arrows.

label: Humanoid Robot
purpose: Represent a humanoid or bipedal robot as a product, feature, or content subject.
use_when: Use when the interface refers to humanoid robots, embodied AI, or robotics products and content.
avoid_when: Do not use for software-only AI agents, chatbots, or assistants without a physical body; use an agent lifecycle icon instead.
depicts: A bipedal robot with a rectangular head, torso, arms angled outward, and two legs.

label: Lidar Sensor
purpose: Represent a lidar or range sensor scanning its surroundings.
use_when: Use for lidar, proximity sensing, and perception systems in robotics and vehicles.
avoid_when: Do not use for wifi or network signal strength; use a signal icon instead.
depicts: A sensor dot with radiating range arcs and a sweep line.

label: Loader Orbit
purpose: Show indeterminate progress while an agent or system works.
use_when: Use for in-progress operations without a known duration, such as tool calls or fetches.
avoid_when: Do not use when progress percentage is known; use the progress ring instead.
depicts: A dotted orbit ring with a satellite dot around a core.

label: Machine to Machine Pay
purpose: Represent an autonomous machine-to-machine payment between agents.
use_when: Use for agent-to-agent settlement, autonomous transactions, and m2m billing.
avoid_when: Do not use for human peer-to-peer payments; use a person-based payment icon instead.
depicts: Two machines exchanging a coin over a dashed link.

label: MCP Connector
purpose: Represent an MCP server or protocol connection between an agent and a capability.
use_when: Use for MCP servers, connector settings, and integration status in agent tooling.
avoid_when: Do not use for physical power plugs or charging; use an electrical icon instead.
depicts: A connector plug with two prongs and a trailing cable.

label: Memory Store
purpose: Represent agent memory, recall, or a context store.
use_when: Use for agent memory features, recall surfaces, and long-term context stores.
avoid_when: Do not use for plain databases without a memory meaning; use a database icon instead.
depicts: A database cylinder with a pulse line inside.

label: Orchestrator
purpose: Represent a supervisor agent coordinating multiple worker agents.
use_when: Use for supervisor and orchestrator roles in multi-agent architecture diagrams and dashboards.
avoid_when: Do not use for load balancers or network fan-out without an agent meaning.
depicts: A supervisor node fanned out to three worker nodes.

label: Pipeline Run
purpose: Represent a running workflow pipeline of connected stages.
use_when: Use for agent workflows, chained steps, and pipeline run views.
avoid_when: Do not use for physical pipelines or plumbing.
depicts: Three connected stages: node, process box, and node.

label: Plan Branches
purpose: Show an agent decomposing a goal into branching subtasks.
use_when: Use for plan visibility, task breakdowns, and to-do trees in agent interfaces.
avoid_when: Do not use for git branching; use a version control icon instead.
depicts: A root node branching into two task nodes.

label: Progress Ring
purpose: Show determinate progress toward completing a task.
use_when: Use when a task has measurable progress, such as batch exports or multi-step plans.
avoid_when: Do not use for unknown-duration waits; use the orbit loader instead.
depicts: A partial ring sweep around a clock glyph.

label: Prompt Field
purpose: Represent a prompt input where humans instruct an AI.
use_when: Use for prompt boxes, instruction fields, and ask-AI entry points.
avoid_when: Do not use for generic search fields; use a search icon instead.
depicts: An input field with a text caret and a spark.

label: Prompt Injection
purpose: Warn about prompt injection attacks entering an input.
use_when: Use for prompt injection detections, input sanitization alerts, and security scans.
avoid_when: Do not use for medical injections or vaccines.
depicts: An input field with an arrow injecting from above and an alert inside.

label: Quantum Chip
purpose: Represent a quantum processing unit or quantum chip.
use_when: Use for quantum processors, QPU capacity, and quantum hardware features.
avoid_when: Do not use for classical CPUs or NPUs; use the edge AI chip instead.
depicts: A pinned chip containing crossed electron orbit ellipses.

label: Qubit Sphere
purpose: Represent a qubit state on a Bloch sphere.
use_when: Use for quantum bits, quantum state visualizations, and quantum computing features.
avoid_when: Do not use for globes or planets.
depicts: A sphere with an equator ellipse and a state vector arrow.

label: Retry Route
purpose: Show that an agent is retrying or rerouting after a failure.
use_when: Use when a failed step is automatically retried or routed down a recovery path.
avoid_when: Do not use for manual refresh actions; use a plain refresh icon instead.
depicts: A circular retry arrow around a route node.

label: Robot Arm
purpose: Represent an industrial robot arm or manipulator.
use_when: Use for industrial automation, manufacturing robotics, and manipulator controls.
avoid_when: Do not use for prosthetics or human arms.
depicts: A jointed robot arm on a base with an open gripper.

label: Robot Dog
purpose: Represent a quadruped robot such as an inspection or patrol robot.
use_when: Use for quadruped robots, site inspection bots, and robotics fleet views.
avoid_when: Do not use for pets or animal content.
depicts: A four-legged robot body with a sensor head and tail antenna.

label: Sandbox Run
purpose: Show code or actions executing inside an isolated sandbox.
use_when: Use for sandboxed execution, isolated runs, and safe evaluation environments.
avoid_when: Do not use for 3D or package contexts; use a box icon instead.
depicts: An isometric cube with a checkmark on its front face.

label: Skill Module
purpose: Represent an installable agent skill or plugin capability.
use_when: Use for agent skills, plugins, and capability marketplaces.
avoid_when: Do not use for jigsaw or puzzle games.
depicts: A puzzle piece with a plus spark at the top right.

label: Spend Limit
purpose: Represent a spending cap or budget ceiling on agent payments.
use_when: Use for spend limits, budget ceilings, and payment policy controls on agent wallets.
avoid_when: Do not use for rate limits on API calls; use a throttling icon instead.
depicts: A wallet with an upward arrow stopped by a dashed ceiling.

label: Stablecoin
purpose: Represent a stablecoin or pegged digital currency.
use_when: Use for stablecoin balances, pegged settlement rails, and stable-value assets.
avoid_when: Do not use for volatile cryptocurrencies or fiat cash.
depicts: A coin bearing a double bar equals mark for the peg.

label: Streaming Caret
purpose: Show that an AI response is streaming in token by token.
use_when: Use while model output is streaming into a chat bubble, editor, or document.
avoid_when: Do not use for long-running background work with no visible output; use a loader or progress icon instead.
depicts: Three text lines with a blinking caret at the streaming edge.

label: Terminal Agent
purpose: Represent a terminal-native coding agent or CLI assistant.
use_when: Use for CLI agents, terminal sessions driven by AI, and shell integrations.
avoid_when: Do not use for plain terminals without an agent meaning; use a standard terminal icon instead.
depicts: A terminal window with a prompt chevron and a spark.

label: Thinking Pulse
purpose: Show that an AI agent is reasoning, planning, or deciding what to do next.
use_when: Use when an AI agent is preparing an answer, evaluating options, or choosing a next step and you want a calm in-progress signal distinct from a generic spinner.
avoid_when: Do not use when the agent is actively executing changes, waiting for human approval, blocked, or failed; use the matching lifecycle icon instead.
depicts: Two brain lobes with a pulse line running through the center.

label: Token Meter
purpose: Show token usage or budget consumption for a session or task.
use_when: Use for token counters, usage budgets, and cost meters in agent tooling.
avoid_when: Do not use for currency or payments; use a payment icon instead.
depicts: A coin-like double ring with a partial usage arc.

label: Tool Call
purpose: Represent an agent invoking a tool or function call.
use_when: Use for tool call entries in agent transcripts, traces, and permission prompts.
avoid_when: Do not use for general settings or configuration; use a gear icon instead.
depicts: Function parentheses around a lightning bolt.

label: Voice Agent
purpose: Represent a voice-first AI agent or speech interface.
use_when: Use for voice assistants, speech input, and audio-first agent products.
avoid_when: Do not use for music or podcast content; use a media icon instead.
depicts: A symmetric waveform with a spark at the top right.

label: X402 Payment
purpose: Represent the x402 machine payment protocol built on HTTP 402.
use_when: Use for x402 protocol support, HTTP 402 payment-required flows, and machine payment rails.
avoid_when: Do not use for generic HTTP errors or paywalled articles.
depicts: A badge with the number 402 and diagonal motion strokes.
